scenario: LDAP password expires in 24 hours, re-validate through the campus login portal
subject: Password will expire in 24 hours
body:
Your LDAP password will expire in 24 hours and must be revalidated for continued access to campus resources. Please click the link below to ensure uninterrupted access.

https://portal.training.invalid/verify

Thank you for your attention to this matter. If you have any questions, please contact the IT Service Desk.

IT Service Desk

IIT Hyderabad

Do not share this information with anyone. If you did not initiate this request, please ignore this email.
